Class Simulation

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.compile.Model
com.eco.bio7.simulation.Simulation
Direct Known Subclasses:
AgentModel, GeoAgentModel, GridModel, ValueGridModel
public abstract class Simulation extends Model
The base class of the simulation models of the simulation API (see GridModel, ValueGridModel and AgentModel). A model implements init() (the start state) and step() (one time step). Bio7 calls them with the Setup button and the Play/Pause button (the time interval of the Play/Pause button sets the speed); the model is displayed in an ImageJ image (grids) or in the 3D view (agents).

The same model runs in the web browser: "Export Simulation as HTML..." (in the menu of the Play/Pause button) translates the model class to JavaScript. Fields with the annotation Param become controls of the page and of the "Settings" view in Bio7. The random numbers of random() are the same in Java and JavaScript (same seed, same numbers).

The translation supports a subset of Java: fields, methods, static nested classes, control flow, arrays, Math, lambdas, ArrayList and String concatenation (see the documentation of the export for the details).

    • click

      public void click(double x, double y)
      A click of the mouse in the view of the model (override it): for a grid the position in cells (the cell ((int) x, (int) y), y from the top as in get(x, y)), for an agent model the point on the floor of the box. Called between the steps (also when the simulation is paused; the view is updated after the call), in the HTML export with the same values.
      Parameters:
      x - the x position
      y - the y position

    • drag

      public void drag(double x, double y)
      A drag of the mouse in the view of the model (override it), e.g., to paint cells: called for the position where the drag started and for each further position (a grid: each new cell). In the 2D view a drag with the left mouse button, in the 3D view with the Shift key (a drag without it rotates the view). The positions as in click(double, double).
      Parameters:
      x - the x position
      y - the y position

    • key

      public void key(String key)
      A key pressed in the view of the model (override it): a character ("a", "A", "1", " ") or the name of a special key ("ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "Enter", "Escape", "Backspace", "Delete", "Tab"; the names of the key of JavaScript). With this method, the view gives the keys to the model (not to its own shortcuts).
      Parameters:
      key - the key

    • run

      public void run()
      Description copied from class: Model
      The main method which is called from the calculation thread!
      Overrides:
      run in class Model

    • settings

      public org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Composite settings(org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Composite parent)
      An own panel for the settings in Bio7 (null: the settings of the Param fields and Action methods are created). Create, e.g., a Composite designed with the WindowBuilder: return new MySettings(parent, SWT.NONE);. Its widgets are bound to the model by the names of its fields (a Scale "feed" to the Param field feed, a push Button "addSeed" to the Action method addSeed(), see SimulationSettings.bind(Object, Simulation)). The HTML export creates the controls of the Param fields and Action methods (this method is not exported).
      Parameters:
      parent - the parent of the panel (the "Settings" view)
      Returns:
      the panel or null

    • randomAt

      public double randomAt(int index)
      A random number in [0, 1) for an index (e.g., of a cell or an agent) in this time step: computed from the seed, the time step and the index (no common sequence), so it can be used in parallel threads (e.g., IntStream.range(0, height).parallel().forEach(...)) and gives the same numbers in any order of the threads, in Java and in JavaScript.

    • rk4

      public static double[] rk4(Simulation.Derivatives f, double t, double[] y, double dt)
      One step of the Runge-Kutta method (4th order) for dy/dt = f(t, y), e.g., a Lotka-Volterra model: 
      y = rk4((t, v) -> new double[] { a * v[0] - b * v[0] * v[1], c * v[0] * v[1] - d * v[1] }, t, y, 0.01);
      Returns:
      the values at t + dt (a new array)

      Loads an image (PNG with transparency, JPEG) for drawImage and the agents (agent.image = name). A relative path is searched in the project of the model; the HTML export embeds the image.

    • loadModel

      public void loadModel(String name, String file)
      Loads a 3D model (glTF: .glb or .gltf, also animated; Wavefront OBJ with the materials and textures of its .mtl file, y up; STL, binary or ASCII, z up) for the agents (agent.model = name, agent.animation = the name of an animation) and placeModel. A relative path is searched in the project of the model; the HTML export embeds the model (OBJ and STL converted to glTF).
